title: Predictive Risk Monitoring (IoT + AI)
description:
Deploy IoT sensors (fire, flood, water leak, structural health)
AI models to analyze sensor data and predict risk events (e.g., overheating, water damage, structural instability)

key_dependencies: IoT sensor platforms, PowerUp analytics layer, underwriting PAS (UKRIS/DxC PAS), Claims Center, client-facing dashboards.
implementation_timeline: Medium–High – described by Andrew Hall as more of a longer-term bet but strategically important.
